title: Result record
description: One line of the result file (`*.jsonl`): one JSON object, UTF-8, no BOM, terminated by LF. Readers must ignore unknown properties.

source_url.description: Canonical URL of the page (README "Canonical URL"). Since 2026-11-14: the page's declared canonical address (`<link rel="canonical">` or the `Link` header, same site) when the run trusts canonicals; the address loaded is then `requested_url`.

requested_url.description: Present only when the URL as discovered or listed differs from `source_url` (redirect or normalisation).

source_key.description: Present only when the job's `urls` entry carried a `key`.

item_index.description: Position of the item on the page: 0 for a page without variants; the variant's position when the mapping has `variants` (one record per variant).

variant.description: Added 2026-11-13. Present on a variant's record: its position among the page's variants (`index` = `item_index`), how many the page has, the variant source kind, the option values (name → value, the shop's words) and the shop's variant id when it has one.

price_status.description: Added 2026-11-14. Present on every record of a template with a field of type `price` (the field named `price`, else the first `price` field): `shown` — the field has a value; `range` — the page showed a range, the field holds its lowest value and `price_max` the highest; `on_request` — no price and the page says it is given on request (an empty price block with request wording, or a schema.org offer without a price); `missing` — no price and no sign why (README 6.5).

price_max.description: Added 2026-11-14. With `price_status: range` only: the highest value of the range.

regular_price.description: Added 2026-11-14. Present when the page (or the variant) shows a sale: the old, struck-through or regular price; `data`'s price field holds the current price. From a variant's own regular price (WooCommerce `display_regular_price`, Shopify `compare_at_price`, Store API `regular_price`), else schema.org `priceSpecification` with `priceType` StrikethroughPrice/ListPrice, else the struck-through amount of the product's price block (`del`, `s`, `strike`, line-through, `old-price`, `price-old`, `was`, `compare-at` …) — when this record's price is the page's current price (README 6.5).

currency_from_default.description: Added 2026-11-14. Present (true) when a `currency` field holds the `default_currency` of its `currency` transform because the page names no currency. A default currency on a record without a price is dropped (the field is `null`); when the page names a currency elsewhere (schema.org `priceCurrency`, `product:price:currency`, a price element), that one is used instead (README 6.5).

data.description: Every field of the template's mapping is present: `null` (or `[]` for `multiple`) when not found.
